## Games

### Niners Chemnitz cruise past Löwen Braunschweig in BBL Pokal

Niners Chemnitz dominated Löwen Braunschweig 102:75 in the BBL Pokal, advancing to the quarterfinals. The Chemnitz team, led by coach Rodrigo Pastore, took control from the start, building a 31:10 lead by the end of the first quarter. Despite a late surge by Braunschweig, Chemnitz maintained their lead, with Ben Burnham scoring 24 points. For Braunschweig, DeJour Reaves led the team with 16 points, but the Löwen were unable to mount a significant challenge. The loss marks the end of Braunschweig's BBL Pokal campaign, while Chemnitz will face a new challenge in the quarterfinals.

### Skyliners defeat Gladiators Trier in Netto BBL Pokal

The Frankfurt Skyliners defeated the Vet-Concept Gladiators Trier 78-65 in the Netto BBL Pokal. The Gladiators struggled with poor shooting percentages and a lack of flow, which ultimately led to their defeat. Jordan Roland led the Gladiators with 15 points. The Skyliners took an early lead and never looked back, with Thomas Klepeisz scoring the first points of the game. The Gladiators had trouble converting their shots, and despite some early attempts, they remained scoreless for three minutes. Eli Brooks eventually broke the drought with a basket, but the Gladiators continued to struggle, and the Skyliners took a 15-22 lead into the first quarter break. The Skyliners continued to build on their lead in the second quarter, while the Gladiators struggled to find their offense. The Gladiators' Behnam Yakhchali scored 13 points, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Skyliners' strong performance.

### Hamburg Falls Short Against Bayern in Netto BBL Pokal

Veolia Towers Hamburg was eliminated from the Netto BBL Pokal after a 63:85 loss to FC Bayern München Basketball in the quarterfinals. Emil Marshall made his debut for Hamburg and scored his first points in the game. Matthys Kangudia led the team with 16 points. Coach Benka Barloschky stated that Hamburg's shooting performance was lacking, and that Bayern's experience and size gave them an advantage. Osaro Rich noted that when Bayern gets into a rhythm, it's difficult for Hamburg to come back from a significant deficit. Despite the loss, Rich was pleased with Marshall's debut and the opportunity to score his first points. Marshall himself reflected on the game, saying that while it was a tough loss, he was proud of the team's effort, particularly in the first quarter.

### Alba Berlin Secure Cup Quarterfinal Spot with 83:71 Win over Bamberg

Alba Berlin secured their spot in the Netto BBL Cup quarterfinals with an 83:71 win over BMA365 Bamberg Baskets on October 19. The game was played in front of 8,615 fans at the Uber Arena, with Alba Berlin overcoming a long-time deficit to take control of the game. Justin Bean and Malte Delow were key contributors for Alba Berlin, who will now face Phoenix Hagen in the quarterfinals. Alba Berlin's captain, Jonas Mattisseck, praised the team's ability to adapt to the game, while head coach Pedro Calles highlighted the importance of mental toughness and team cohesion. Bamberg's head coach, Jesús Ramírez, congratulated Alba Berlin on their win and wished them well in the remainder of the cup competition and the season.

### ALBA Berlin Dethrone Cup Champs Bamberg in Thrilling Netto BBL Pokal Match

ALBA Berlin knocked out reigning Netto BBL Pokal German Cup winners BMA365 Bamberg Baskets 83-71 to reach the Quarter-Finals. The match was a thrilling one, with Bamberg taking a strong lead in the first half, but Berlin's defense tightened up in the second half, allowing them to take control of the game. Berlin's Justin Bean led the scoring with 20 points, followed by Malte Delow with 18. Bamberg's Richard Balint had 13 points, and Mylik Wilson had a double-double with 10 points and 12 rebounds. The win marks a significant upset for Berlin, who are now just three wins from winning their record 12th championship. The Quarter-Finals will be played from December 11-14, with Berlin set to face Phoenix Hagen.

### Rostock Seawolves' Home Game Against Aris Thessaloniki Sold Out

The Rostock Seawolves' home game against Aris Thessaloniki on October 20th is sold out. The game, which will be broadcast live by MagentaSport starting at 19:50, marks the first time in the team's EuroCup history that a home game has been completely sold out. The opposing team, Aris Thessaloniki, has been impressive in the BKT EuroCup, winning their three games so far with a minimum of 13-point margins. They are currently leading their group with a 3-0 record and are one of five teams that have yet to lose a game in the competition. Aris's roster includes several experienced players, including Jeremiah Robinson-Earl, E.J. Liddell, and Khem Birch, as well as the Antetokounmpo brothers, Kostas and Thanasis. The game will be played under high security measures due to the reputation of Aris's fans for their passionate and temperamental support.

### Syntainics MBC Head to Lausanne for European North Basketball League Matchup

Syntainics MBC will face Pully Lausanne Foxes in the European North Basketball League (ENBL) on Wednesday. This is the team's second trip to Switzerland in their history, and their first ENBL season game was a 106:84 win over Bristol Flyers last week. The Foxes have lost their first three games, including a 71:94 defeat to Kapfenberg and an 88:97 loss to Tiflis in Georgia. Syntainics MBC coach Vladimir Jovanovic has a connection to the Foxes, as the team's sport director Silvano Poropat was the coach of Syntainics MBC in the 2012/13 season, when Chad Timberlake was the team's top scorer. Timberlake is now the coach of Syntainics MBC and will face his former team in Lausanne.

### SYNTAINICS MBC extends Mushidi, releases Clyburn

The SYNTAINICS MBC has announced two roster moves ahead of their ENBL game against Pully Lausanne Foxes. Kostja Mushidi has extended his contract with the team until the end of the 2026/27 season, while Kris Clyburn will leave the team with immediate effect. Clyburn's original contract, which was set to run until 2028, has been terminated. In 8 games for the SYNTAINICS MBC in the easyCredit BBL, Netto BBL Pokal, and ENBL, Clyburn averaged 17.3 minutes per game and scored 6.3 points. Mushidi, who returned to the team before the season, averaged 13.1 points in 21.1 minutes per game in the same period. The team's Geschäftsführer, Alexander Rolle, stated that Clyburn had requested the termination of his contract, citing that the team had not performed as expected. The team has thanked Clyburn for his contributions in 39 games and wishes him well for his future.

Sources:

- [Syntainics MBC: Kostja Mushidi bleibt, Kris Clyburn geht](https://syntainics-mbc.de/kostja-mushidi-bleibt-kris-clyburn-geht)

### Vechta's U19 Team Falls Short in Ligapokal Group Stage

Rasta Vechta's U19 team had a chance to secure a spot in the Ligapokal semifinals after their opening win against Oldenburg, but a 65:77 loss to ALBA Berlin on Sunday put them in a tight spot. The team, led by Head Coach Hendrik Gruhn, fought hard despite being short-handed, with Moritz Grüß scoring 16 points and Epke Kruthaup adding 13 points and six assists. However, ALBA's aggressive defense and 16 steals proved too much for Vechta, who committed 28 turnovers and shot just 42% from the field. With the group stage finale against Frankfurt on Sunday, Vechta still has a chance to reach the semifinals, but will need a win to secure their spot. The team is currently missing four players due to injury, including Louis Sutor, Tristan Gutersohn, Alan Chojnacki, and Malik Herges.
